NMR: Bruker 200 MHz Solid State NMR Spectrometer-Keck
LOCATION
Keck B08
PRICING
Rice User Fee: $3/hr 
Non-Profit Fee: $4.70/hr 
For Profit Fee: $75/hr for solid state work done by SEA research scientist plus $120/hr for sample preparation by SEA research scientist and any requested detailed interpretation of spectra or consulting by SEA research scientist 
Rice Training Fee: $12/hr 
Non-Profit Training Fee: $19/hr 
CONTACTS
Training Contact:
You must have required SEA paperwork on file with Rachel Berins before training can occur.  Please contact the Shared Equipment Authority at sharedequipauth@rice.edu for training requests and/or questions related to SEA user paperwork.
DESCRIPTION
Please visit the following website for more information: 
https://research.rice.edu/sea/nuclear-magnetic-resonance-nmr
The Bruker Avance III 200 MHz Solid-State NMR Spectrometer is equipped with a two-channel wide-bore magic-angle spinning (MAS) probe. MAS spinning speeds up to 15 kHz can be achieved using standard 4 mm zirconia rotors at room temperature. Both 1H-X cross-polarization (CP) and direct X-nucleus pulse experiments are available for characterizing atomic-level chemical structures in solid materials, including powders, single crystals, and amorphous samples. 
Sample Requirements:
Approximately 85 mg of solid sample is required for a 4 mm ZrO₂ MAS rotor.
Solid samples must be finely powdered. Samples can be ground using a mortar and pestle or a ball mill.
All samples must be completely dry.
Samples must not be conductive or ferromagnetic.
The operating principles of solid-state NMR differ significantly from those of solution NMR. For a brief introduction to these principles, please refer to this page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solid-state_nuclear_magnetic_resonance.  To discuss the use of this instrument for your research, please contact Dr. Xu Wang at xw75@rice.edu. Spectrometer time is reserved through the FOM calendar.
